metaTitle: How Cell Signal Boosters Work in an RV
description: Learn how an RV cell signal booster amplifies weak signal with an outside antenna, amplifier and inside antenna, plus gain limits, placement and FCC rules.
directAnswer: A booster captures a weak tower signal with an outside antenna, amplifies it and rebroadcasts it inside, improving both downloads and uploads. It cannot create signal from nothing, and antenna separation and mounting height decide results.
